passages.text: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid or discouraged. Take the whole army with you, and go up and attack Ai. See, I have delivered into your hand the king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Joshua.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD said, “Do not be afraid.
Do not be discouraged.
Take all the fighting men with you.
Go up to the city of Ai.
Attack Ai.
I have given you victory over Ai.
I have delivered the king of Ai into your hand.
I have given you his people.
I have given you his city.
I have given you his land.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ אַל־ תִּירָ֣א וְאַל־ תֵּחָ֔ת קַ֣ח עִמְּךָ֗ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ עַ֣ם הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְק֖וּם עֲלֵ֣ה הָעָ֑י רְאֵ֣ה׀ נָתַ֣תִּי בְיָדְךָ֗ אֶת־ מֶ֤לֶךְ הָעַי֙ וְאֶת־ עַמּ֔וֹ וְאֶת־ עִיר֖וֹ וְאֶת־ אַרְצֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And you shall do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king, except that you may carry off their plunder and livestock for yourselves. Set up an ambush behind the city.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Joshua.
God commanded Joshua to attack the city of Ai.
God told Joshua to treat Ai and its king the same way he treated Jericho and its king.
God allowed the Israelites to take the plunder from Ai.
God allowed the Israelites to take the livestock from Ai.
God told Joshua to set up an ambush behind the city of Ai.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ לָעַ֜י וּלְמַלְכָּ֗הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשִׂ֤יתָ לִֽירִיחוֹ֙ וּלְמַלְכָּ֔הּ רַק־ שְׁלָלָ֥הּ וּבְהֶמְתָּ֖הּ תָּבֹ֣זּוּ לָכֶ֑ם שִׂים־ לְךָ֥ אֹרֵ֛ב לָעִ֖יר מֵאַחֲרֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: So Joshua and the whole army set out to attack Ai. Joshua chose 30,000 mighty men of valor and sent them out at night with these orders: “Pay attention. You are to lie in ambush behind the city, not too far from it. All of you must be ready.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel’s army.
He gathered all the fighting men.
Joshua and the whole army prepared to attack the city of Ai.
Joshua chose 30,000 strong and brave warriors.
He sent these men out during the night.
Joshua gave them clear orders.
He said, “Pay attention.
You must hide in ambush behind the city of Ai.
Do not go far from the city.
All of you must be ready.”
passages.original: וַיָּ֧קָם יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ וְכָל־ עַ֥ם הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה לַעֲל֣וֹת הָעָ֑י וַיִּבְחַ֣ר יְ֠הוֹשֻׁעַ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים אֶ֤לֶף אִישׁ֙ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י הַחַ֔יִל וַיִּשְׁלָחֵ֖ם לָֽיְלָה׃ וַיְצַ֨ו אֹתָ֜ם לֵאמֹ֗ר רְ֠אוּ אַתֶּ֞ם אֹרְבִ֤ים לָעִיר֙ מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י הָעִ֔יר אַל־ תַּרְחִ֥יקוּ מִן־ הָעִ֖יר מְאֹ֑ד וִהְיִיתֶ֥ם כֻּלְּכֶ֖ם נְכֹנִֽים׃

passages.text: Then I and all the troops with me will advance on the city. When they come out against us as they did the first time, we will flee from them.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua spoke to his soldiers.
Joshua said, “I and all the people with me will go near the city.
The city was Ai.
If the men of Ai come out to fight us, as they did before, we will run away from them.
We will flee in front of them.”
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֗י וְכָל־ הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתִּ֔י נִקְרַ֖ב אֶל־ הָעִ֑יר וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי־ יֵצְא֤וּ לִקְרָאתֵ֙נוּ֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּרִֽאשֹׁנָ֔ה וְנַ֖סְנוּ לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: They will pursue us until we have drawn them away from the city, for they will say, ‘The Israelites are running away from us as they did before.’ So as we flee from them, you are to rise from the ambush and seize the city, for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua spoke to the soldiers who waited in ambush.
Joshua said, “The men of Ai will chase us.
They will follow us until we have led them away from their city.
They will say, ‘The Israelites are running away from us, just like before.’
We will run away from them.
You must rise from your hiding place.
You must take the city.
The LORD your God will give the city into your hand.”
passages.original: וְיָצְא֣וּ אַחֲרֵ֗ינוּ עַ֣ד הַתִּיקֵ֤נוּ אוֹתָם֙ מִן־ הָעִ֔יר כִּ֣י יֹֽאמְר֔וּ נָסִ֣ים לְפָנֵ֔ינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בָּרִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה וְנַ֖סְנוּ לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃ וְאַתֶּ֗ם תָּקֻ֙מוּ֙ מֵהָ֣אוֹרֵ֔ב וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ הָעִ֑יר וּנְתָנָ֛הּ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֖ם בְּיֶדְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: And when you have taken the city, set it on fire. Do as the LORD has commanded! See, I have given you orders.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua spoke to the people.
Joshua gave them orders from the LORD.
Joshua said, "When you capture the city, set the city on fire."
Joshua said, "Do what the LORD has commanded."
Joshua said, "See, I have given you these orders."
passages.original: וְהָיָ֞ה כְּתָפְשְׂכֶ֣ם אֶת־ הָעִ֗יר תַּצִּ֤יתוּ אֶת־ הָעִיר֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ רְא֖וּ צִוִּ֥יתִי אֶתְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: So Joshua sent them out, and they went to the place of ambush and lay in wait between Bethel and Ai, to the west of Ai. But Joshua spent that night among the people.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua sent his men out.
The men went to the place of ambush.
They waited between Bethel and Ai.
This place was west of Ai.
Joshua stayed with the people that night.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלָחֵ֣ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ אֶל־ הַמַּאְרָ֔ב וַיֵּשְׁב֗וּ בֵּ֧ין בֵּֽית־ אֵ֛ל וּבֵ֥ין הָעַ֖י מִיָּ֣ם לָעָ֑י וַיָּ֧לֶן יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ בַּלַּ֥יְלָה הַה֖וּא בְּת֥וֹךְ הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: Joshua got up early the next morning and mobilized his men, and he and the elders of Israel marched before them up to Ai.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
He got up early in the morning.
He gathered all the people.
He prepared the people for action.
Joshua went up toward Ai.
The elders of Israel went with him.
Joshua and the elders walked in front of the people.
passages.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֤ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וַיִּפְקֹ֖ד אֶת־ הָעָ֑ם וַיַּ֨עַל ה֜וּא וְזִקְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לִפְנֵ֥י הָעָ֖ם הָעָֽי׃

passages.text: Then all the troops who were with him marched up and approached the city. They arrived in front of Ai and camped to the north of it, with the valley between them and the city.
passages.sermon:
Joshua led the Israelite troops.
All the fighting men with Joshua marched up together.
They approached the city of Ai.
They arrived and stood in front of Ai.
They set up camp to the north of Ai.
A valley lay between the Israelite camp and the city of Ai.
passages.original: וְכָל־ הָעָ֨ם הַמִּלְחָמָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֗וֹ עָלוּ֙ וַֽיִּגְּשׁ֔וּ וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ נֶ֣גֶד הָעִ֑יר וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ מִצְּפ֣וֹן לָעַ֔י וְהַגַּ֖י בֵּינוֹ וּבֵין־ הָעָֽי׃

passages.text: Now Joshua had taken about five thousand men and set up an ambush between Bethel and Ai, to the west of the city.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua took about five thousand men.
He set these men in ambush.
He placed them between Bethel and Ai.
He put them to the west of the city of Ai.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֕ח כַּחֲמֵ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים אִ֑ישׁ וַיָּ֨שֶׂם אוֹתָ֜ם אֹרֵ֗ב בֵּ֧ין בֵּֽית־ אֵ֛ל וּבֵ֥ין הָעַ֖י מִיָּ֥ם לָעִֽיר׃

passages.text: So the forces were stationed with the main camp to the north of the city and the rear guard to the west of the city. And that night Joshua went into the valley.
passages.sermon:
Joshua led the Israelites.
He prepared for battle against the city of Ai.
He placed the main camp north of the city.
He stationed the rear guard west of the city.
That night, Joshua went into the valley.
passages.original: וַיָּשִׂ֨ימוּ הָעָ֜ם אֶת־ כָּל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁר֙ מִצְּפ֣וֹן לָעִ֔יר וְאֶת־ עֲקֵב֖וֹ מִיָּ֣ם לָעִ֑יר וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ בַּלַּ֥יְלָה הַה֖וּא בְּת֥וֹךְ הָעֵֽמֶק׃

passages.text: When the king of Ai saw the Israelites, he hurried out early in the morning with the men of the city to engage them in battle at an appointed place overlooking the Arabah. But he did not know that an ambush had been set up against him behind the city.
passages.sermon:
The king of Ai saw the Israelites.
He acted quickly.
He got up early in the morning.
He went out with all the men of his city.
They went to fight Israel.
They met Israel at a set place.
This place was in front of the Arabah.
The king of Ai did not know about the ambush.
The ambush was behind the city.
Someone had set up this ambush against him.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֞י כִּרְא֣וֹת מֶֽלֶךְ־ הָעַ֗י וַֽיְמַהֲר֡וּ וַיַּשְׁכִּ֡ימוּ וַיֵּצְא֣וּ אַנְשֵֽׁי־ הָעִ֣יר לִקְרַֽאת־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל לַֽמִּלְחָמָ֞ה ה֧וּא וְכָל־ עַמּ֛וֹ לַמּוֹעֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י הָֽעֲרָבָ֑ה וְהוּא֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔ע כִּֽי־ אֹרֵ֥ב ל֖וֹ מֵאַחֲרֵ֥י הָעִֽיר׃

passages.text: Joshua and all Israel let themselves be beaten back before them, and they fled toward the wilderness.
passages.sermon:
Joshua led the people of Israel.
Joshua and all Israel faced the men of Ai.
Joshua and all Israel turned away from the men of Ai.
Joshua and all Israel fled toward the wilderness.
passages.original: וַיִּנָּֽגְע֛וּ יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיָּנֻ֖סוּ דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃

passages.text: Then all the men of Ai were summoned to pursue them, and they followed Joshua and were drawn away from the city.
passages.sermon:
All the people who were in the city of Ai heard a call to action.
They were summoned to chase after the Israelites.
They began to pursue Joshua.
They left the city behind as they chased him.
They were drawn away from their city.
passages.original: וַיִּזָּעֲק֗וּ כָּל־ הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּעִיר לִרְדֹּ֖ף אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וַֽיִּרְדְּפוּ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַיִּנָּתְק֖וּ מִן־ הָעִֽיר׃

passages.text: Not a man was left in Ai or Bethel who did not go out after Israel, leaving the city wide open while they pursued Israel.
passages.sermon:
All the men in Ai and Bethel left their cities.
They went out to chase after Israel.
No man stayed behind in either city.
They left the city gates open.
They all pursued Israel.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ נִשְׁאַ֣ר אִ֗ישׁ בָּעַי֙ וּבֵ֣ית אֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יָצְא֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּעַזְב֤וּ אֶת־ הָעִיר֙ פְּתוּחָ֔ה וַֽיִּרְדְּפ֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Hold out your battle lance toward Ai, for into your hand I will deliver the city.” So Joshua held out his battle lance toward Ai, and as soon as he did so, the men in ambush rose quickly from their position. They rushed forward, entered the city, captured it, and immediately set it on fire.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Joshua.
The LORD gave Joshua a command.
The LORD said, "Hold out your battle lance toward Ai."
The LORD promised Joshua victory.
The LORD said, "I will give the city into your hand."
Joshua obeyed the LORD.
Joshua held out his battle lance toward Ai.
Men from Israel waited in ambush near the city.
As soon as Joshua raised his lance, the men in ambush acted.
The men in ambush rose quickly from their place.
They ran toward the city.
They entered the city.
They captured the city.
They hurried to set the city on fire.
They burned the city immediately.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ נְ֠טֵה בַּכִּיד֤וֹן אֲשֶׁר־ בְּיָֽדְךָ֙ אֶל־ הָעַ֔י כִּ֥י בְיָדְךָ֖ אֶתְּנֶ֑נָּה וַיֵּ֧ט יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ בַּכִּיד֥וֹן אֲשֶׁר־ בְּיָד֖וֹ אֶל־ הָעִֽיר׃ וְהָאוֹרֵ֡ב קָם֩ מְהֵרָ֨ה מִמְּקוֹמ֤וֹ וַיָּר֙וּצוּ֙ כִּנְט֣וֹת יָד֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ הָעִ֖יר וַֽיִּלְכְּד֑וּהָ וַֽיְמַהֲר֔וּ וַיַּצִּ֥יתוּ אֶת־ הָעִ֖יר בָּאֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: When the men of Ai turned and looked back, the smoke of the city was rising into the sky. They could not escape in any direction, and the troops who had fled to the wilderness now became the pursuers.
passages.sermon:
The men of Ai were soldiers who fought against Israel.
They turned around and looked back.
They saw smoke rising from their city.
The smoke went up into the sky.
They realized their city was burning.
They could not escape in any direction.
They had no way to run away.
The Israelite troops had pretended to flee into the wilderness.
Now these Israelite troops turned back.
The Israelite troops became the pursuers.
They began to chase the men of Ai.
passages.original: וַיִּפְנ֣וּ אַנְשֵׁי֩ הָעַ֨י אַחֲרֵיהֶ֜ם וַיִּרְא֗וּ וְהִנֵּ֨ה עָלָ֜ה עֲשַׁ֤ן הָעִיר֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יְמָה וְלֹא־ הָיָ֨ה בָהֶ֥ם יָדַ֛יִם לָנ֖וּס הֵ֣נָּה וָהֵ֑נָּה וְהָעָם֙ הַנָּ֣ס הַמִּדְבָּ֔ר נֶהְפַּ֖ךְ אֶל־ הָרוֹדֵֽף׃

passages.text: When Joshua and all Israel saw that the men in ambush had captured the city and that smoke was rising from it, they turned around and struck down the men of Ai.
passages.sermon:
Joshua led the people of Israel.
Joshua and all Israel looked at the city of Ai.
They saw that the men in ambush had captured the city.
They saw smoke rising from the city.
Joshua and all Israel turned back toward Ai.
They attacked the men of Ai.
They struck down the men of Ai.
passages.original: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ וְכָֽל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל רָא֗וּ כִּֽי־ לָכַ֤ד הָֽאֹרֵב֙ אֶת־ הָעִ֔יר וְכִ֥י עָלָ֖ה עֲשַׁ֣ן הָעִ֑יר וַיָּשֻׁ֕בוּ וַיַּכּ֖וּ אֶת־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י הָעָֽי׃

passages.text: Meanwhile, those in the ambush came out of the city against them, and the men of Ai were trapped between the Israelite forces on both sides. So Israel struck them down until no survivor or fugitive remained.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites set an ambush against Ai.
The men in ambush came out of the city.
They came out to attack the men of Ai.
The men of Ai were caught between two groups of Israelites.
One group of Israelites stood on one side.
Another group of Israelites stood on the other side.
The men of Ai were trapped in the middle.
The Israelites attacked the men of Ai.
They struck them down.
No one from Ai survived.
No one from Ai escaped.
passages.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה יָצְא֤וּ מִן־ הָעִיר֙ לִקְרָאתָ֔ם וַיִּֽהְי֤וּ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בַּתָּ֔וֶךְ אֵ֥לֶּה מִזֶּ֖ה וְאֵ֣לֶּה מִזֶּ֑ה וַיַּכּ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔ם עַד־ בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר־ ל֖וֹ שָׂרִ֥יד וּפָלִֽיט׃

passages.text: But they took the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.
passages.sermon: The Israelites fought against the city of Ai.\r\nThey captured the king of Ai alive.\r\nThey brought the king of Ai to Joshua.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ מֶ֥לֶךְ הָעַ֖י תָּ֣פְשׂוּ חָ֑י וַיַּקְרִ֥בוּ אֹת֖וֹ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ׃

passages.text: When Israel had finished killing all the men of Ai who had pursued them into the field and wilderness, and when every last one of them had fallen by the sword, all the Israelites returned to Ai and put it to the sword as well.
passages.sermon:
Israel fought against the people of Ai.
The people of Ai chased Israel into the field and the wilderness.
Israel killed all the people of Ai who had pursued them.
Every one of them fell by the sword.
After this, all the Israelites returned to the city of Ai.
Israel struck the city of Ai with the sword.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י כְּכַלּ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל לַהֲרֹג֩ אֶת־ כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֨י הָעַ֜י בַּשָּׂדֶ֗ה בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רְדָפ֣וּם בּ֔וֹ וַֽיִּפְּל֥וּ כֻלָּ֛ם לְפִי־ חֶ֖רֶב עַד־ תֻּמָּ֑ם וַיָּשֻׁ֤בוּ כָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הָעַ֔י וַיַּכּ֥וּ אֹתָ֖הּ לְפִי־ חָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: A total of twelve thousand men and women fell that day—all the people of Ai.
passages.sermon:
The people of Ai lived in the city of Ai.
On that day, twelve thousand people from Ai died.
These people included both men and women.
All the people of Ai fell that day.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֩ כָל־ הַנֹּ֨פְלִ֜ים בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ מֵאִ֣ישׁ וְעַד־ אִשָּׁ֔ה שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף כֹּ֖ל אַנְשֵׁ֥י הָעָֽי׃

passages.text: Joshua did not draw back the hand that held his battle lance until he had devoted to destruction all who lived in Ai.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua held his battle lance in his hand.
Joshua stretched out his hand with the lance.
Joshua did not draw back his hand.
Joshua kept his hand outstretched.
Joshua did this until he destroyed all who lived in Ai.
passages.original: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ לֹֽא־ הֵשִׁ֣יב יָד֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָטָ֖ה בַּכִּיד֑וֹן עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶחֱרִ֔ים אֵ֖ת כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָעָֽי׃

passages.text: Israel took for themselves only the cattle and plunder of that city, as the LORD had commanded Joshua.
passages.sermon:
Israel took the cattle from that city.
Israel took the plunder from that city.
The LORD had commanded Joshua to do this.
Israel obeyed the LORD’s command.
passages.original: רַ֣ק הַבְּהֵמָ֗ה וּשְׁלַל֙ הָעִ֣יר הַהִ֔יא בָּזְז֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ׃

passages.text: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a permanent heap of ruins, a desolation to this day.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
\r\nJoshua burned the city of Ai.
\r\nHe destroyed Ai completely.
\r\nHe made Ai a heap of ruins.
\r\nAi has remained a desolate place.
\r\nAi is still a ruin to this day.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׂרֹ֥ף יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ אֶת־ הָעָ֑י וַיְשִׂימֶ֤הָ תֵּל־ עוֹלָם֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: He hung the king of Ai on a tree until evening, and at sunset Joshua commanded that they take down the body from the tree and throw it down at the entrance of the city gate. And over it they raised a large pile of rocks, which remains to this day.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
\r\nJoshua captured the king of Ai.
\r\nJoshua hung the king of Ai on a tree.
\r\nHe left the king’s body on the tree until evening.
\r\nAt sunset, Joshua gave a command.
\r\nThe people took the king’s body down from the tree.
\r\nThey threw the body at the entrance of the city gate.
\r\nThey built a large pile of rocks over the body.
\r\nThat pile of rocks is still there today.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ מֶ֧לֶךְ הָעַ֛י תָּלָ֥ה עַל־ הָעֵ֖ץ עַד־ עֵ֣ת הָעָ֑רֶב וּכְב֣וֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ וַיֹּרִ֧ידוּ אֶת־ נִבְלָת֣וֹ מִן־ הָעֵ֗ץ וַיַּשְׁלִ֤יכוּ אוֹתָהּ֙ אֶל־ פֶּ֙תַח֙ שַׁ֣עַר הָעִ֔יר וַיָּקִ֤ימוּ עָלָיו֙ גַּל־ אֲבָנִ֣ים גָּד֔וֹל עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ

passages.text: At that time Joshua built an altar on Mount Ebal to the LORD, the God of Israel, just as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded the Israelites. He built it according to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses: “an altar of uncut stones on which no iron tool has been used.” And on it they offered burnt offerings to the LORD, and they sacrificed peace offerings.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua built an altar.
He built the altar on Mount Ebal.
He built the altar for the LORD, the God of Israel.
Moses was the servant of the LORD.
Moses had commanded the Israelites to build such an altar.
Joshua followed the command of Moses.
Joshua built the altar as it is written in the Book of the Law of Moses.
The altar was made of uncut stones.
No iron tool had touched the stones.
The Israelites offered burnt offerings on the altar to the LORD.
They also sacrificed peace offerings on the altar.
passages.original: אָ֣ז יִבְנֶ֤ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לַֽיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּהַ֖ר עֵיבָֽל׃ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּה֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה עֶֽבֶד־ יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּכָּתוּב֙ בְּסֵ֙פֶר֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִזְבַּח֙ אֲבָנִ֣ים שְׁלֵמ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־ הֵנִ֥יף עֲלֵיהֶ֖ן בַּרְזֶ֑ל וַיַּעֲל֨וּ עָלָ֤יו עֹלוֹת֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וַֽיִּזְבְּח֖וּ שְׁלָמִֽים׃

passages.text: And there in the presence of the Israelites, Joshua inscribed on the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he had written.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
\r\nHe stood before all the Israelites.
\r\nJoshua took stones.
\r\nHe wrote on the stones.
\r\nHe wrote a copy of the law of Moses.
\r\nMoses had written this law before the Israelites.
\r\nJoshua inscribed this law on the stones for everyone to see.
passages.original: וַיִּכְתָּב־ שָׁ֖ם עַל־ הָאֲבָנִ֑ים אֵ֗ת מִשְׁנֵה֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּתַ֔ב לִפְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: All Israel, foreigners and citizens alike, with their elders, officers, and judges, stood on both sides of the ark of the covenant of the LORD facing the Levitical priests who carried it. Half of the people stood in front of Mount Gerizim and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded earlier, to bless the people of Israel.
passages.sermon:
All the people of Israel gathered together.
The elders of Israel stood with them.
The officers of Israel stood with them.
The judges of Israel stood with them.
Foreigners were among them.
Citizens were among them.
They all stood on both sides of the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
The Levitical priests carried the ark.
The people faced the priests who carried the ark.
Half of the people stood in front of Mount Gerizim.
The other half stood in front of Mount Ebal.
Moses was the servant of the LORD.
Moses had commanded them to do this.
He commanded them to bless the people of Israel in this way.
passages.original: וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל וּזְקֵנָ֡יו וְשֹׁטְרִ֣ים׀ וְשֹׁפְטָ֡יו עֹמְדִ֣ים מִזֶּ֣ה׀ וּמִזֶּ֣ה׀ לָאָר֡וֹן נֶגֶד֩ הַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַלְוִיִּ֜ם נֹשְׂאֵ֣י׀ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֗ה כַּגֵּר֙ כָּֽאֶזְרָ֔ח חֶצְיוֹ֙ אֶל־ מ֣וּל הַר־ גְּרִזִ֔ים וְהַֽחֶצְי֖וֹ אֶל־ מ֣וּל הַר־ עֵיבָ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֜ה מֹשֶׁ֣ה עֶֽבֶד־ יְהוָ֗ה לְבָרֵ֛ךְ אֶת־ הָעָ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּרִאשֹׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: Afterward, Joshua read aloud all the words of the law—the blessings and the curses—according to all that is written in the Book of the Law.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel after Moses.
Joshua stood before the people of Israel.
Joshua read aloud all the words of the law.
He read the blessings.
He read the curses.
He read everything written in the Book of the Law.
passages.original: וְאַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֗ן קָרָא֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֣י הַתּוֹרָ֔ה הַבְּרָכָ֖ה וְהַקְּלָלָ֑ה כְּכָל־ הַכָּת֖וּב בְּסֵ֥פֶר הַתּוֹרָֽה׃

passages.text: There was not a word of all that Moses had commanded that Joshua failed to read before the whole assembly of Israel, including the women, the little ones, and the foreigners who lived among them.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel after Moses.
Moses had commanded many things from God.
Joshua read every word that Moses had commanded.
He read all these words to the whole assembly of Israel.
He read to the men.
He read to the women.
He read to the children.
He read to the foreigners living among them.
Joshua did not leave out a single word that Moses had commanded.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ הָיָ֣ה דָבָ֔ר מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ קָרָ֜א יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ נֶ֣גֶד כָּל־ קְהַ֤ל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְהַנָּשִׁ֣ים וְהַטַּ֔ף וְהַגֵּ֖ר הַהֹלֵ֥ךְ בְּקִרְבָּֽם׃פ
